spec.title: Port 01
spec.description: Latest link state within the last five minutes.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "zyxel_interface" and
    r.source == "192.168.10.7"
    and r.index == "1"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ifHighSpeed" or r._field == "ifOperStatus")

  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["_time"],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    exists r.ifHighSpeed and exists r.ifOperStatus
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    _value:
      if r.ifOperStatus == 1 then int(v: r.ifHighSpeed)
      else if r.ifOperStatus == 2 then 0
      else -1,
    _field: if exists r.ifAlias and r.ifAlias != ""
            then r.ifAlias
            else r.ifDescr
  }))

  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

import "strings"
import "join"
import "array"

status = 
from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "zyxel_interface" and
    r.source == "192.168.10.7"
    and r.index =~ /^([1-9]|10)$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ifHighSpeed" or r._field == "ifOperStatus")

  |> last()
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["index"],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    exists r.ifHighSpeed and exists r.ifOperStatus
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    Port: int(v: r.index),
    Alias: if exists r.ifAlias then r.ifAlias else "",
    Speed:
      if r.ifOperStatus == 1 then int(v: r.ifHighSpeed)
      else if r.ifOperStatus == 2 then 0
      else -1
  }))
  |> group()

traffic = 
from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "zyxel_interface" and
    r.source == "192.168.10.7"
    and r.index =~ /^([1-9]|10)$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ifHCInOctets" or r._field == "ifHCOutOctets" or r._field == "ifHighSpeed")

  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["_time"],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    exists r.ifHCInOctets and
    exists r.ifHCOutOctets and
    exists r.ifHighSpeed
  )
  |> derivative(
    columns: ["ifHCInOctets", "ifHCOutOctets"],
    unit: 1s,
    nonNegative: true
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.ifHighSpeed > 0 and
    exists r.ifHCInOctets and
    exists r.ifHCOutOctets
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    index: r.index,
    rx: float(v: r.ifHCInOctets) * 8.0,
    tx: float(v: r.ifHCOutOctets) * 8.0,
    rx_util: float(v: r.ifHCInOctets) * 800.0 /
             (float(v: r.ifHighSpeed) * 1000000.0),
    tx_util: float(v: r.ifHCOutOctets) * 800.0 /
             (float(v: r.ifHighSpeed) * 1000000.0)
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["index"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {rx: 0.0, tx: 0.0, ru: 0.0, tu: 0.0, n: 0},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      rx: accumulator.rx + r.rx,
      tx: accumulator.tx + r.tx,
      ru: accumulator.ru + r.rx_util,
      tu: accumulator.tu + r.tx_util,
      n: accumulator.n + 1
    })
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    Port: int(v: r.index),
    RX: r.rx / float(v: r.n),
    TX: r.tx / float(v: r.n),
    RX_util: r.ru / float(v: r.n),
    TX_util: r.tu / float(v: r.n)
  }))
  |> group()

errors = 
from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "zyxel_interface" and
    r.source == "192.168.10.7"
    and r.index =~ /^([1-9]|10)$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ifInErrors" or r._field == "ifOutErrors")

  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["_time"],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> difference(
    columns: ["ifInErrors", "ifOutErrors"],
    nonNegative: true
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    exists r.ifInErrors and exists r.ifOutErrors
  )
  |> group(columns: ["index"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {rx: 0, tx: 0},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      rx: accumulator.rx + int(v: r.ifInErrors),
      tx: accumulator.tx + int(v: r.ifOutErrors)
    })
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    Port: int(v: r.index),
    RX_errors: r.rx,
    TX_errors: r.tx
  }))
  |> group()

rawNeighbours = 
from(bucket: "monitoring")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "zyxel_lldp" and
    r.source == "192.168.10.7"
  )

  |> last()
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["index"],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    Port: int(v: strings.split(v: r.index, t: ".")[1]),
    Neighbour:
      if exists r.remote_system_name and
         r.remote_system_name != ""
      then r.remote_system_name
      else if exists r.remote_port_id
      then r.remote_port_id
      else "",
    Remote_port:
      if exists r.remote_port_id then r.remote_port_id else ""
  }))
  |> group()

neighbours = union(tables: [
  rawNeighbours,
  array.from(rows: [{
    Port: -1, Neighbour: "", Remote_port: ""
  }])
])
  |> group()

st = join.left(
  left: status,
  right: traffic,
  on: (l, r) => l.Port == r.Port,
  as: (l, r) => ({
    l with
    RX: r.RX,
    TX: r.TX,
    RX_util: r.RX_util,
    TX_util: r.TX_util
  })
)

ste = join.left(
  left: st,
  right: errors,
  on: (l, r) => l.Port == r.Port,
  as: (l, r) => ({
    l with
    RX_errors: r.RX_errors,
    TX_errors: r.TX_errors
  })
)

join.left(
  left: ste,
  right: neighbours,
  on: (l, r) => l.Port == r.Port,
  as: (l, r) => ({
    l with Neighbour: r.Neighbour
  })
)
  |> sort(columns: ["Port"])
